# Hanzo Network

> Hanzo Network is a blockchain for AI workloads (chain ID 36963) with an OpenAI-compatible API at api.hanzo.ai. Live today: the chain, the API and nodes paid per job in stablecoins; designed and not active: Proof of AI mining, the 2T AI supply policy and P3Q settlement.

> ## Agent Instructions
> For the current source of truth read https://hanzo.network/llms.txt and https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms.txt. Connect Hanzo's MCP server: `npx -y hanzo mcp`.

## Connect your agent

Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add --scope user hanzo -- npx -y hanzo mcp
```

Codex:

```bash
codex mcp add hanzo -- npx -y hanzo mcp
```

Cursor and other MCP clients:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hanzo": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "hanzo", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Hosted, needs sign-in:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http hanzo-cloud https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/mcp
```

- [MCP docs](https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/mcp/): How Hanzo's MCP server works and what it offers.
- [Hanzo docs index](https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms.txt): The index of Hanzo's documentation for agents.
- [Hanzo docs, full text](https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms-full.txt): All of Hanzo's documentation in one file.

## Network details

| | Mainnet | Testnet | Devnet |
|---|---|---|---|
| RPC | https://api.hanzo.network/v1/bc/hanzo/rpc | https://api.hanzo-test.network/v1/bc/hanzo/rpc | Local: `hanzod --network devnet` (needs a committee file, see https://github.com/hanzoai/node) |
| Chain ID | 36963 | 36962 | 36964 |
| Currency | AI | none | none |
| Explorer | https://explore.hanzo.network | none | none |

AI is the chain's native coin. The 2 trillion cap and mining policy are designed and not active (see Economics below).

Run a validator (In progress). This opts the machine in: hanzod fetches, verifies and starts the chain as a child process. It works with mainnet, testnet or devnet; `hanzo chain status` shows where it stands and `hanzo chain down` opts out. Mining rewards stay off until the launch gates pass.

```bash
hanzo chain up testnet
```

- [Network docs](https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/network): What the network is and how to connect.
- [Node operator guide](https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/proof-of-ai/node-operator): What a node does today and what is roadmap.
- [Node source](https://github.com/hanzoai/node): The node and devnet instructions; source-available, not open source.

## Make a call

Make a first call to the API (needs an API key from https://platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys):

```bash
curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $HANZO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"hanzo/zen","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```

Read the chain, no key needed:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.hanzo.network/v1/bc/hanzo/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[]}'
```

- [API keys](https://platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys): Sign in with a Hanzo account and create a key.
- [Pricing](https://hanzo.network/pricing): Per-token prices for every model billed per token, read live from the API.

## How Proof of AI checks

Designed, not active. About 95% of a model's forward pass is matrix multiplication, C = A*B. Redoing it costs cubic work. Checking it does not. After the provider commits C, the chain draws a random vector r, and an ordinary CPU checks A(Br) = Cr in quadratic work. A wrong product slips through with probability at most 1/p per vector, where p = 2^61 - 1; two vectors bring that to at most 2^-122. The committed trace frontier is about 768 bytes. This proves each opened product; it does not by itself prove a whole model, and sampling covers the rest.

The Proof of AI paper and the related-work section are under Sources.

## Solutions

- [Verifiable inference](https://hanzo.network/build): Designed. Call models through one OpenAI-compatible API today; Proof of AI receipts are designed for open models such as Zen and are not switched on.
- [Mine AI with useful compute](https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/proof-of-ai/node-operator): Designed. Providers keep the customer fee and, if mining activates, may also earn a declining AI reward; mining stays disabled until the launch gates pass, and today a node runs tools and agents and is paid per job in stablecoins.
- [Agents and metered compute](https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/agents): Live. Give an agent its own API key with a monthly budget and calls stop when it is spent; on-chain agent wallets with spend caps are designed.
- [Models, training and contributions](https://hips.hanzo.ai/docs/hip-0901-proof-of-ai-native-execution-proofs): Designed. Zen open-weight models are served today; proofs for training and rewards for private contributions are specified in a draft proposal.
- [Private post-quantum AI](https://papers.hanzo.ai/hanzo-ai-chain/): Designed. Prompt sealing with X-Wing (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) and optional secure enclaves are specified; succinct settlement on Z-Chain is audit-gated.

## Status of the network

- Live: chain 36963, the OpenAI-compatible API at api.hanzo.ai, and nodes that run tools and agents and are paid per job in stablecoins.
- hanzod is one Rust daemon per machine: local inference, Dev, Bot and Team backends and an optional validator. Today a node runs tools and agents and is paid per job in stablecoins.
- Blocks are produced on chain 36963 today, with a post-quantum handshake and ML-DSA validator identities. Post-quantum finality is designed and audit-gated.
- Designed, not active: Proof of AI mining, the 2T AI supply policy and P3Q settlement. Mining stays disabled until the launch gates in the whitepaper pass.
- [Status page](https://status.hanzo.network): Hanzo's platform status; it does not monitor the chain RPC.

## Economics

AI is already the native coin of chain 36963. The supply cap and mining policy below are designed and not active: mining stays disabled until governance fixes the parameters and the launch gates pass.

Designed in the whitepaper and not active:

- Hard cap: 2 trillion AI (2T).
- Hanzo DAO, fixed at genesis: 1T AI. It can never be mined.
- Earned by proved work, nothing else: 1T AI, in halving eras.
- Era caps: the first era may emit at most 500B AI, the second 250B, the third 125B, and so on.
- Fee burn: Delta S = issuance - beta * fees, where beta is the governed share of settled protocol fees that is burned. Beta is not set yet.
- Market (Designed): compute pricing is designed around a market maker that conserves one quantity as supply and demand move: H(Psi,Theta) = Psi*Theta = kappa, where Psi and Theta are the two sides of the pool and kappa stays constant. It is a design; no market contract is deployed. The source is under Sources.
- [Economics on hanzo.network](https://hanzo.network/economics): The supply, the halving eras and the burn, with an illustrative calculator.
